full_prompt_en: This square editorial cartoon stages a tense face-to-face exchange between two suited men in a narrow doorway. The man at left stands partly inside a yellow-lit opening. He has swept bright blond hair, heavy dark brows, a compressed scowl, a blue suit, white shirt, and vivid red tie. His hand holds a gray sheet of paper near the lower center. Opposite him, a taller gray-haired man leans in from the right. A long pointed nose, wide white eyes, creased cheeks, and an open grimacing mouth exaggerate his expression. He wears a black jacket over a pleated white shirt and black bow tie, and one hand gathers dark fabric at the chest. Their faces nearly meet at the center, creating a sharp triangular gap between noses and brows. Behind the blond figure, the bright doorway supplies a flat warm yellow rectangle framed by brown trim. Behind the other, an ash-gray block wall recedes with sparse joint lines and scratchy hatch marks. The lower right is almost entirely black clothing, which anchors the exaggerated pale face above it. Thick ink contours mark brows, wrinkles, hands, and folds; thin hatching in the background and on the suits gives the otherwise flat color small pockets of depth. Light seems to spill from the doorway onto the left figure, while the right figure remains against cooler gray. The visible paper has marks but no readable wording. The cartoon is theatrical and confrontational, using compressed space, inflated features, and a decisive contrast between warm light, blue cloth, and black shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形社论漫画把两位西装男子紧张的面对面对话放在狭窄门口。左边男子部分站在黄色受光的开口内。他有向侧面梳的亮金发、粗重深眉和紧绷怒容，穿蓝色西装、白衬衫与鲜红领带。他的手在画面下方中央附近握着一张灰纸。对面更高的灰发男子从右边倾身过来。长而尖的鼻子、睁圆的白眼、皱起的面颊和张开的龇牙嘴夸张了他的表情。他穿黑外套、带褶白衬衫和黑领结，一只手在胸前拢住深色衣料。两张脸几乎在中央碰到一起，鼻与眉之间形成尖锐三角空隙。金发人物背后，明亮门洞提供一块平整的暖黄矩形，四周有棕色门框。另一人身后是灰色砌块墙，只有稀疏的接缝线和刮擦状排线。右下几乎全由黑衣占据，稳住其上方夸大的浅色面孔。厚墨轮廓标出眉、皱纹、手和衣褶；背景与西装上的细排线则为平涂色增添小片纵深。光似乎从门洞溢出照到左侧人物，右侧人物仍处在较冷的灰背景前。纸上有痕迹，却没有可读文字。漫画戏剧化而带对抗性，依靠压缩空间、膨胀的面部特征和暖光、蓝衣、黑影的明确对照。
style_prompt_en: Editorial cartoon drawing pushes proportions and facial geometry into expressive exaggeration while keeping body language easy to read. Heavy black outlines and small angled hatch marks sharpen folds, creases, and abrupt changes of plane. Broad flat areas of blue, black, gray, and warm yellow give a restrained palette a strong value structure, with one bright red accent supplying a focal jolt. Close framing compresses opposing shapes into direct visual tension. Simple environmental lines support the action without competing with it, producing a brisk, satirical image with theatrical lighting.
style_prompt_zh: 社论漫画绘制把比例与面部几何推向富表情的夸张，同时让身体姿态一眼可读。厚黑轮廓与小型斜排线强化衣褶、皱纹和突然变化的平面。蓝、黑、灰与暖黄的大块平涂为克制色盘建立强明度结构，一处鲜红重音带来焦点冲击。近景取景把对立形状压成直接的视觉张力。简化环境线支撑动作而不与之争抢，形成节奏明快、带舞台式光线的讽刺画面。
theme_en: Two sharply caricatured suited men confronting each other in a doorway
theme_zh: 两位夸张描绘的西装男子在门口对峙
name: Walt Handelsman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
